AsamI18n
ts
export interface AsamI18n {
    /** False for an unconfigured legacy tree; formatters preserve their existing defaults. */
    readonly enabled: ComputedRef<boolean>;
    readonly locale: ComputedRef<string>;
    readonly requestedLocale: ComputedRef<string>;
    readonly nativeLocale: ComputedRef<AsamNativeLocale | undefined>;
    readonly issues: ComputedRef<readonly AsamI18nIssue[]>;
    t(...args: AsamI18nCall): string;
    dispose(): void;
}

ts
type Path<T> = T extends ReadonlyArray<infer V> ? IsTuple<T> extends true ? { [K in TupleKey<T>]-?: PathImpl<Exclude<K, symbol>, T[K]> }[TupleKey<T>] : PathImpl<ArrayKey, V> : { [K in keyof T]-?: PathImpl<Exclude<K, symbol>, T[K]> }[keyof T];

type IsTuple<T extends ReadonlyArray<any>> = number extends T['length'] ? false : true;

type TupleKey<T extends ReadonlyArray<any>> = Exclude<keyof T, ArrayMethodKey>;
